heard: Michael Saylor once lost $6 billion in a single day.
said: Michael Saylor once lost six billion dollars in a single day.

heard: March 20, 2000. His company, MicroStrategy, admits its earnings were wrong.  //
said: March twentieth, two thousand. His company, MicroStrategy, admits its earnings were wrong.

heard: August 2020, MicroStrategy puts $250 million into Bitcoin.
said: August twenty twenty. MicroStrategy puts two hundred fifty million dollars into Bitcoin.

heard: and it never stops buying. No public company holds more bitcoin.
